sections.heading: From solidarity to accountable response
paragraphs: Condolence recognises public suffering and can signal official attention. Its practical value depends on whether competent authorities separately provide verified information, emergency care, family assistance, investigation and prevention measures. The supplied record does not confirm such actions, so they should not be attributed to it.

A common misconception is that a senior expression of grief proves the cause of an incident or the adequacy of the response. It does neither; causation, responsibility and remedial action require independent evidence.
